title: Mall world dreams
content: Idk why I have so many dreams of the mall world since I was young . I’ve only been to a mall a couple times in my life and dont watch a lot of movies especially when I was younger but I think it’s cool other people have similiar dreams as me.I have the other dreams also like school / university world. I’ve had the dirty bathrooms dream about two times, beach world , indoor waterslides that go outside like sum kinda big pool hotel building thing. a couple weeks ago I had a dream about being on sum kinda pier there were big waves and alligator lol dont know why i have these kinda dreams I live in Canada in the country. I think it’s cool tho we all have similiar dreams, I always tried to explain my dreams to people irl and they never seemed to understand glad I found this group it’s only been a couple weeks but most of the posts I can resonate with or have some kinda familiar feeling some more than others but ya just thought I’d share that
